newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint ends firmer vs dlr in slack trade.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint ends firmer vs dlr in slack trade.

text.p: Hungary's forint ended slightly up versus the dollar in a quiet market on Monday, dealers said.
The forint finished at 162.45/50 against the dollar, unchanged from midday but stronger than its 162.58 opening.
"There are not many deals these days," said Attila Behan of ING Bank. "The forint's just following the dollar/mark. It's a balanced market with nothing really to trade on."
Behan added he did not expect any change this week in the current, low key mood.
Lacklustre currency trading was also seen in the Budapest Commodity Exchange's (BCE) futures market, which saw turnover of only 1.26 billion forints.
The mark was most popular, falling in January, February and March but rising for December. Sterling, the dollar and yen rose for most contracts. The Ecu, lira and Swiss franc were steady.
